identity.name: Hürriyet Daily News
identity.description: Turkey's oldest English-language newspaper, covering Turkish politics, foreign policy, business, society and regional affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Published by Hürriyet Gazetecilik ve Matbaacılık A.Ş.; Demirören Medya holds 81.21% and 18.79% is free float. The Demirören group has close ties to the Turkish government.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Demirören Medya's controlling stake and the group's close relationship with the Turkish government create strong commercial and political alignment pressures.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed as centrist with a pro-government and nationalist tilt on security and foreign policy.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage generally favours Turkish corporate interests and market-friendly policy.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Turkish national lens aligned with official foreign-policy priorities, including NATO membership and regional security.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established English-language daily with professional reporting, but ownership ties and Turkey's media environment constrain adversarial coverage.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for Hürriyet Daily News.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Turkish national coverage in English, strongest on politics, diplomacy and business, with a pro-establishment orientation.

selectionRationale: Adds a Turkish national English-language perspective and a bridge between Europe and the Middle East.

feeds.validationNote: 64 items; valid RSS; legacy /rss endpoint returned malformed feed.

research.researchNotes: Ownership from Demirören Medya disclosures and Wikipedia. Official About page was not captured. Feed validated via /rss/news. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
